name: SERB Research Scientist (SRS) Scheme
funder: Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF, formerly SERB), Government of India
amount: Rs 1,20,000/month consolidated + Rs 7 lakh/year research grant + Rs 1 lakh/year overhead
other_rules: Open only to INSPIRE Faculty Fellows and Ramanujan Fellows who have completed (or are within 6 months of completing) their 5-year tenure without a regular position
cannot be held at the PhD department or institution
notes: Bridge after Ramanujan or INSPIRE Faculty. 2 years, extendable by 1 year on performance (3 years maximum). Apply within 6 months before or after the end of the tenure.
